在 [ZnO Γ 点偏振练习](../index.html#compute/ph: In the [ZnO Γ polarization exercise](../index.html#compute/phonon-modes?preset=zno-ir), apply the published Born effective charges to the Γ-point eigenvectors. Both E₂ optical doublets have zero Born projection. The 6mm table places E₂ in the quadratic channel (x²−y², xy), so normalized teaching tensors can compare parallel and crossed polarizations. Rotating by 45° interchanges the two tensor-channel weights. The input files give frequencies and displacement eigenvectors. For Raman tensors and intensities measured in ZnO, see the original experiment. [ZnO Raman tensor measurements](https://journals.aps.org/prb/abstract/10.1103/PhysRevB.85.165208)
[Rashba 时间反演练习](../index.html#classroom/: The [Rashba time-reversal exercise](../index.html#classroom/foundations?module=mini&experiment=bands&preset=rashba-trim-check) uses the reciprocal fraction κ from the Kramers lesson. The wavevector is expressed in lattice units, giving the model input k/π=2κ. With zero Zeeman term the same-momentum gaps vanish at κ=0 and ½. A splitting can still occur at κ=0.2. Adding B=0.30 preserves the matching spectra at positive and negative k. Direct comparison of ΘH(k)Θ⁻¹ and H(−k) gives a residual of 0.60, and both time-reversal-invariant momenta acquire a gap of 0.60. [Rashba spin–orbit and Zeeman terms](https://topocondmat.org/w2-majorana/nanowire)
